name: spawn_daemon
description: Spawn a daemon process that automatically restarts when it terminates (up to max_restarts times). Useful for long-running background services like file watchers or knowledge indexers.

name.description: Short name for the daemon process.

goal.description: The goal or task for the daemon to accomplish on each run.

priority.description: Process priority on a 0-255 scale (0=highest, 255=lowest). Default is 10.

quota_turns.description: Max turns per run. Default is 10.

max_restarts.description: Maximum number of automatic restarts when the daemon terminates. Default is 3.
